events.title: Zamzam camp — pre-war civilian baseline
events.body: Shelter rows and market lanes as a civilian IDP city. This is the before-state for later burn/disruption records. Not a military site.

events.title: Kalma camp — civilian baseline
events.body: Large civilian IDP camp south of Nyala. Vehicle parks are humanitarian and civilian. Do not relabel as a yard.

events.title: Krinding camp — civilian baseline
events.body: West Darfur civilian camp. Later 2023 attacks are scored against this baseline.

events.title: Heglig flares — industrial baseline (negative)
events.body: Persistent stack flares at the oil facility. Night thermal here defaults industrial unless a new tank scar appears.

events.title: Khartoum — war opens at army HQ, palace, airport
events.body: Fighting begins at SAF General Command, the palace, and Khartoum International. Vehicle columns and smoke in open reporting. This is the first-seen date for the capital campaign, not a targeting product.

events.title: Khartoum International — airfield seized / contested
events.body: RSF occupation of the airport is in contemporaneous reporting. Runway and terminal damage accumulate. Occupancy later reverses (SAF 2025). Airfield morphology, not a cargo claim.

events.title: Wadi Seidna — air base contested
events.body: Northern Khartoum air base in the opening battles. Large airframes may appear on later 10 m scenes; type is unresolved.

events.title: Merowe Airport — RSF holds then loses the field
events.body: RSF captures 15 Apr; SAF retakes by 19 Apr; RSF leaves Merowe 21 Apr. Classic airfield-control event. No inference of what sat on the apron.

events.title: El Obeid Airport — opening claim
events.body: RSF claims the airport the day the war starts. The city stays in a long siege under SAF. Treat the claim as a first-seen dispute, not confirmed enduring control.

events.title: Yarmouk complex — explosions in industrial Khartoum
events.body: Open reporting of blasts at the military-industrial site. Surrounding civilian housing. Do not inventory munitions from satellite.

events.title: Al-Jaili refinery — fire / control fight
events.body: Refinery and tank farm become a campaign objective. Industrial fire is not automatically a combat explosion class without optical follow-up.

events.title: Shambat Bridge — Nile crossing contested
events.body: Control of Nile bridges structures all capital movement (civilian, aid, and armed). First public fighting at the crossing.

events.title: Al-Naw Hospital — civilian hospital disrupted
events.body: Omdurman civilian hospital. Medical networks report disruption from the first week. Civilian-harm record.

events.title: Khartoum Teaching Hospital — service collapse begins
events.body: Major civilian hospital in the opening battles. Not a military site.

events.title: Nyala — first clashes at 16th Division / city
events.body: Opening-week clashes, then ceasefires, then a later siege. First-seen date is 15 Apr 2023.

events.title: El Fasher siege begins (6th Division + city)
events.body: Siege clock starts before the capital battle in some reconstructions. First-seen for the 2.5-year siege.

events.title: Kutum and Kassab camp — town falls
events.body: Battle 30 May–4 Jun 2023. RSF victory in open sources. Kassab is a civilian camp.

events.title: Kassab camp — civilian camp in the Kutum fight
events.body: Civilian camp harmed during the Kutum battle. Civilian-harm archive.

events.title: Kadugli — battle/siege first-seen
events.body: South Kordofan capital. Multi-year fight with SPLM-N and RSF pressure. First-seen 8 Jun 2023.

events.title: Dilling — siege first-seen
events.body: South Kordofan town siege begins. Later lifted Feb 2025.

events.title: El Geneina — city and camps overrun
events.body: Battle of Geneina. Mass civilian harm in West Darfur. Krinding, Ardamata, market, hospital. This is a civilian-harm record, not a force-on-force log.

events.title: El Geneina market — civilian market in the massacre window
events.body: Main market during the June 2023 violence. Civilian site.

events.title: Krinding camp — attack during Geneina violence
events.body: Civilian IDP camp. First-seen harm tied to the June 2023 city assault.

events.title: Adré — displacement surge across the Chad border
events.body: Humanitarian corridor, not an armed logistics claim. First large wave after Geneina.

events.title: Nyala — RSF offensive on the 16th Division
events.body: Siege tightens; 16th Infantry Division base later falls (26 Oct). Vehicle activity at the base is reported, not counted here.

events.title: Nyala 16th Division falls — city control shifts
events.body: RSF capture of the infantry base is the conventional end of the Battle of Nyala. Airport yards become an RSF logistics node in later reporting.

events.title: Ardamata — civilian massacre record
events.body: West Darfur civilian neighbourhood/camp. Open human-rights reporting. Civilian-harm archive. Perpetrator language stays with those reports; this pin is the place and the first-seen date.

events.title: Ed Daein — East Darfur capital control shift
events.body: RSF control of Ed Daein in 2023 open reporting. Civilian city.

events.title: Zalingei — Central Darfur capital control shift
events.body: RSF control in open reporting. Camps on the fringe stay civilian.

events.title: Kabkabiya — west-of-Fasher road node
events.body: Early RSF control. Truck parks on the Geneina–Fasher road mix civilian, aid, and armed traffic. Unresolved at 10 m.

events.title: Wad Madani — RSF seizes Gezira capital
events.body: First battle of Wad Madani. Logistics yards, market, hospital, airfield. Mass displacement. First-seen 15 Dec 2023.

events.title: Wad Madani logistics yards — vehicle surge (range)
events.body: Truck and pickup concentrations in the yards after the city falls. Sentinel-class imagery cannot type pickup vs technical vs civilian 4x4. Count is a band, not a census.

events.title: Hasahisa — Gezira–Khartoum road corridor
events.body: Town on the north road. First-seen with the RSF Gezira push.

events.title: Managil — west Gezira town in the RSF push
events.body: Open reporting of the advance. Civilian town.

events.title: Kosti / White Nile camps — displacement surge
events.body: Gezira flight arrives at White Nile sites. Humanitarian, not military yards.

events.title: Babanusa — siege of the 22nd Division first-seen
events.body: Rail junction. Artillery and siege. First-seen 22 Jan 2024.

events.title: Omdurman — prolonged urban fight, Souq Libya disrupted
events.body: Capital-west campaign. Civilian vehicle market is not a base. First 2024 window.

events.title: Bahri offensive first-seen
events.body: SAF/allies push in Khartoum North. First-seen 26 Sep 2024; city control 17 Feb 2025.

events.title: Al-Fula — West Kordofan capital captured
events.body: RSF captures Al-Fula 19–20 Jun 2024. SAF pulls toward Babanusa.

events.title: Jebel Moya — RSF takes Sennar crossroads
events.body: First-seen 25 Jun 2024. Later SAF recapture by 5 Oct 2024.

events.title: Sennar city — campaign first-seen
events.body: Blue Nile state capital under the Sennar offensive.

events.title: Mazmoum — RSF incursion toward Blue Nile / South Sudan
events.body: Border-leaning Sennar town. Later SAF recapture Mar 2025.

events.title: El Fasher — siege berm / earthworks first public imagery window
events.body: Open-source imagery of earthen siege works around the city. Morphology of a civilian city under siege, not a targeting overlay.

events.title: Zamzam northern sector — burn scar on shelter rows
events.body: Civilian IDP camp. Thermal + optical. Origin undetermined. Civilian-harm archive.

events.title: Tawila — displacement hub west of El Fasher
events.body: Civilians moving out of the siege belt. SLM/civilian presence in open reporting.

events.title: Port Sudan — wartime political/logistics rear
events.body: SAF political base and Red Sea cargo gateway. Quay occupancy is commercial unless a specific airframe/vessel is identified. No cargo claim.

events.title: Kufra south track — chain incomplete
events.body: Night lights at a well stop and a dust line. Libyan origin possible; Sudan entry not observed. Do not complete the chain by inference.

events.title: Wad Madani — SAF recapture
events.body: Second battle. SAF victory 11 Jan 2025. Yards remain a vehicle-morphology watch, not a force census. Reprisal reporting exists; this pin is the control-change date.

events.title: Dilling — siege lifted
events.body: SAF control; link-up toward Kadugli in open sources.

events.title: Bahri — SAF/allies take the city
events.body: End date of the Bahri offensive. Capital campaign turning point.

events.title: Sennar offensive — SAF recapture window
events.body: Most of Sennar State recaptured except small pockets, then Mazmoum/Al-Dali.

events.title: Khartoum International — RSF leaves the airport
events.body: Open reporting 25 Mar 2025. Runway interruption vs 2022 baseline remains a morphology record.

events.title: Khartoum — SAF victory in the capital battle
events.body: Battle of Khartoum end date in open reconstructions. City-scale destruction is a civilian-harm and infrastructure record.

events.title: El Obeid — SAF lifts the long siege (first lift)
events.body: Open reporting of the siege lift. The city remains a drone-target in 2026.

events.title: Jebel Uweinat — remote tri-border fight
events.body: 6–16 Jun 2025. Sparse sensors. Chain often incomplete.
